description: Renovate manages Python dependencies and the uv.lock file; GitHub Actions stay with Dependabot.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Weekly full uv.lock refresh so unpinned deps (e.g. ty) track the latest release through a reviewed PR instead of drifting silently in CI.

packageRules.description: Group dev tooling (linters, type-checkers, test/docs deps) into a single PR.
